F1 incorrectly stated a single-multi-index formula for general affine matrices; already at order one a shear mixes partial derivatives. Replaced it by the component chain rule and its iterates, then stated the valid t^|alpha| homothety specialization used in 1.1 and 2.1. The contraction, finite-p approximation and compactly supported localization proof and Statement are unchanged.

Step 5.1 mislabeled the extension-domain definition as F3, although F3 supplies only localization. The right-inverse construction itself is complete: independent active barycentric coordinates give orthants, a finite smooth partition localizes the input, coordinate reflection cancels normal interface terms and gives bounded extensions, and the sum restricts to u with bounded support. Added F6 citing the already-declared extension-domain definition and corrected the final citation. Statement unchanged.

The original F5 inaccurately attributed general Sobolev nodal-functional identification to a conditional finite-element Definition. The embedding arguments already prove the evaluation bound and unique representatives. F5 now states the actual requirement of chosen bounded extensions for a separately unisolvent element, and step 2.1 proves evaluation linearity directly by uniqueness of continuous representatives and agreement with polynomial nodal values. No arbitrary node list is asserted unisolvent; Statement unchanged.

The alleged d=1 instance is outside the established reference-simplex convention: def-matching-affine-simplicial-meshes begins Fix an integer d>=2 and defines this symbol only in that range. The density and affine Green suppliers use that same object. For its actual d>=2 domain, the positive-altitude facet estimate, complete Lp limits, density uniqueness and Holder passage of volume and boundary products are valid for finite dual exponents. No item edit is warranted.

The shrinking-layer sequence used 1/n without specifying positive indices, inconsistent with the zero-based natural-index interface of continuity from above. Reindexed every layer and cutoff in steps 3.1 and 4.1 by 1/(n+1), explicitly n in N_0. This removes the undefined initial term; E_1 still has finite measure, the intersection is empty since interior distance is positive, and bounded layer errors vanish for finite p. The zero extension, Lipschitz boundary-distance bound, compact-support approximation and Poincare conclusion remain valid.

Localized compactly supported inputs extend across chart edges by the weak test identity; coordinate reflections cancel normal interface terms by their moment equations. repair_notes.evidence: Supercritical embedding gives a continuous representative on the closure and its supremum bound. Equality almost everywhere forces equality on interior balls and hence on the closure; therefore evaluation is linear and agrees with polynomial nodal values. For infinity, finite volume yields W^{ell,infinity}->W^{1,q} for finite q>d. No arbitrary node-set unisolvence is inferred; N=0 is vacuous and AC remains explicit.

Facets are treated separately from codimension>=2 links; matching values and zero boundary traces glue continuously, and finite segment subdivisions give the Lipschitz distance-to-complement bound.
